Container.Name: immich-valkey
Container.Overview: Valkey is an open-source, high-performance key/value store (Redis fork). Used by Immich as a cache and job queue (BullMQ). This is a lightweight component. Must be on the same Docker network as the Immich server. Tuning: maxmemory defaults to 0 (unlimited). For low-memory systems, set to 256mb via Post Arguments. appendonly is enabled for job queue persistence across restarts. Note: Immich officially uses Valkey (not Redis) since their docker-compose.yml references valkey/valkey:9.
Container.Requires: Must be on the same Docker network as the immich-server container.

Config.Name: Path: Data
Config.Description: Persistent Valkey data directory. Stores RDB snapshots and AOF logs for job queue persistence.

Config.Name: --- Advanced (Post Arguments) ---
Config.Description: Valkey tuning. These values are set via Post Arguments (not env vars). To change them, edit the Post Arguments field above.

Config.Name: Info: maxmemory
Config.Description: Current: 0 (unlimited). For low-memory systems, change to 256mb in Post Arguments. Immich uses Valkey only for job queues (BullMQ) and pub/sub, not as primary storage.

Config.Name: Info: appendonly
Config.Description: Current: yes. Enables Append-Only File persistence. Ensures background jobs survive container restarts. Set to 'no' to disable persistence (not recommended).

Config.Name: Info: tcp-keepalive
Config.Description: Current: 60 seconds (default: 300). Faster detection of dead connections in Docker networks.

Config.Name: Info: Storage sizing
Config.Description: Recommended data volume size: Small (<10k photos): 1-2GB. Medium (10k-50k): 2-5GB. Large (>50k): 5-10GB. Stores job queue state and AOF logs.
